_comment: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Q2_K conservative validation matrix, using seven pinned GGUF shards with embedded Engram constants. Historical performance observations below refer to the older recorded files; rerun this matrix for the current revision. Default execution uses layer split. Routed-MoE tensor parallelism has 2/4/8-rank fixture coverage; the first full-checkpoint TP run completed and was slower than layer split. This matrix retains ubatch256, prefill-chunk256, solo-chunk8192 and the disabled-by-default compact gather; optimized measured profiles are recorded separately. Set launch-time TS_CPU_MOE_THREADS explicitly and TS_DSV41_COMPACT_RAW_GATHER=0 to avoid inherited settings changing this baseline. The first TP profile requested CLI48, which did not reach the native pool; default32 is inferred from source and the VM override probe, not a direct pool-width measurement on that host. Later explicit-thread experiments are separate. A compatible llama.cpp V4.1 runtime is unavailable: this blocks a same-model parity claim. Run validate_inference.py against each running endpoint for strict quality checks and repeated timing.

deepseek41-flash-q2k._modalities_note: This matrix exercises text. Image/video use the separately prepared deepseek41.vision.gguf from the pinned official weights and explicit --mmproj; their native/managed fixtures are validated separately. No audio decoder is provided.

text_short.description: Short single-turn text prompt (~2k-token context preamble)

text_long.description: Long-context single-turn text prompt (~2k-token context preamble + passage)

multi_turn.description: 3-turn conversation (~2k-token context preamble), timed on the final turn

json_mode.description: Structured output (response_format json_object) with ~2k-token context preamble

ggml_cuda_layer_cpu_moe4.display: CUDA layer split + 4 CPU MoE layers

ggml_cuda_true_tp.display: CUDA routed-MoE tensor shards; layer attention; host reduction
ggml_cuda_true_tp._reference_note: No llama.cpp mapping until a compatible V4.1 runtime and equivalent execution profile are available. Do not compare different placement modes as an equivalent-profile speedup.
